mapper.sql: ENV_SEQ, RAW_SEQ, MET_KEY, ROW_NO, TEST_S_DT, TEST_E_DT, ZONE_SEQ, (SELECT c.NAME FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_TB z INNER JOIN CHAMBER_TB c ON c.CHAMBER_SEQ = z.CHAMBER_SEQ WHERE z.ZONE_SEQ = RAW_ENV_TB.ZONE_SEQ) AS CHAMBER_NAME, (SELECT z.NAME FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_TB z WHERE z.ZONE_SEQ = RAW_ENV_TB.ZONE_SEQ) AS ZONE_NAME, TEMP, TEMP_PLUS, HMDT, HMDT_PLUS, BRMT, BRMT_PLUS, MEM_ID, MEM_NAME, SIGN_URL, MIG_YN, DEL_YN, DEL_REASON, DEL_MEM_ID, INS_MEM_ID, UDT_MEM_ID
CONCAT('SB', j.SBK_YM, '-', j.SBK_TYPE, LPAD(j.SBK_SEQ, 4, 0), '-', t.TEST_TYPE_CODE, LPAD(t.TEST_NO, 4, 0), IF(j.SBK_REVISION > 0, CONCAT('-', j.SBK_REVISION), ''))
mapper.select: SELECT RAW_SEQ FROM RAW_TB WHERE RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAW_ENV_TB ( RAW_SEQ, MET_KEY, ROW_NO, TEST_S_DT, ZONE_SEQ, MEM_ID, MIG_YN, DEL_YN, INS_MEM_ID, INS_DT ) VALUES ( #{rawSeq}, #{metKey}, #{rowNo}, NOW(), #{zoneSeq}, #{memId}, 0, 0, #{insMemId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEST_E_DT = NOW(), UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0 AND TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL AND TEST_E_DT IS NULL

UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEMP = #{temp}, TEMP_PLUS = #{tempPlus}, HMDT = #{hmdt}, HMDT_PLUS = #{hmdtPlus}, BRMT = #{brmt}, BRMT_PLUS = #{brmtPlus}, MEM_NAME = #{memName}, SIGN_URL = #{signUrl}, UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0
UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET TEST_S_DT = #{testSDt}, TEST_E_DT = #{testEDt}, UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0 AND TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL
UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET ZONE_SEQ = #{zoneSeq}, UDT_MEM_ID = #{udtMemId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0
UPDATE RAW_ENV_TB SET DEL_YN = 1, DEL_REASON = #{reason}, DEL_MEM_ID = #{memId}, DEL_DT = NOW(), UDT_MEM_ID = #{memId}, UDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ENV_SEQ = #{envSeq} AND DEL_YN = 0
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(DATE(e.TEST_S_DT)) AS startDt, MAX(DATE(e.TEST_E_DT)) AS endDt FROM RAW_ENV_TB e JOIN ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RAW_TB r INNER JOIN TEST_TB tt ON r.TEST_SEQ = tt.TEST_SEQ INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB tit ON tt.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = tit.TEST_ITEM_SEQ WHERE r.RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} AND tit.TEST_STNDR_SEQ IN (7, 686, 774, 775) ) AS RE_SP ) s WHERE e.RAW_SEQ = #{rawSeq} AND e.DEL_YN = 0 AND e.TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.TEST_E_DT IS NOT NULL AND ( e.MET_KEY = 'TEL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RAW_MET_TB rmt WHERE rmt.RAW_SEQ = e.RAW_SEQ AND rmt.CHECK_YN = 1 AND ( (e.MET_KEY = 'CE' AND rmt.MET_SEQ IN (0, 1)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE1' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = IF(s.RE_SP = 1, 15, 4)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE2' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = IF(s.RE_SP = 1, 4, 5)) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RE3' AND s.RE_SP = 1 AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 5) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'ESD' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 6) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'RS' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 7) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'EFT' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 8) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'SURGE' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 9) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'CS' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 10) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'MF' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 11) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'VDIP' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 12) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'CLK' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 13) OR (e.MET_KEY = 'DP' AND rmt.MET_SEQ = 14) ) ) )

SELECT e.ENV_SEQ, AS RAW_ID, e.MET_KEY, e.TEST_S_DT, e.TEST_E_DT FROM RAW_ENV_TB e LEFT JOIN RAW_TB r ON r.RAW_SEQ = e.RAW_SEQ LEFT JOIN TEST_TB t ON t.TEST_SEQ = r.TEST_SEQ LEFT JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ LEFT JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ WHERE e.SIGN_URL IN ( SELECT #{signUrl} UNION SELECT ms2.ATCH_FILE_ID FROM MEMBER_SIGN_TB ms1 INNER JOIN MEMBER_SIGN_TB ms2 ON ms2.MEMBER_SEQ = ms1.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE ms1.ATCH_FILE_ID = #{signUrl} ) AND e.ENV_SEQ != #{envSeq} AND e.DEL_YN = 0 AND e.MIG_YN = 0 AND e.TEST_S_DT < #{testEDt} AND (e.TEST_E_DT IS NULL OR e.TEST_E_DT > #{testSDt}) ORDER BY e.TEST_S_DT LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEST_MEMO_TB ( TEST_SEQ, MEMO, INS_MEM_ID, UDT_MEM_ID ) VALUES ( #{testSeq}, #{memo}, #{memId}, #{memId} )
mapper.select: SELECT ZONE_SEQ FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_TB WHERE ZONE_SEQ = #{zoneSeq} FOR UPDATE

SELECT z.ZONE_SEQ, c.CHAMBER_SEQ, c.NAME AS CHAMBER_NAME, z.NAME AS ZONE_NAME, z.MULTI_YN FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_TB z INNER JOIN CHAMBER_TB c ON c.CHAMBER_SEQ = z.CHAMBER_SEQ AND c.USE_YN = 1 INNER JOIN CHAMBER_ZONE_MET_TB m ON m.ZONE_SEQ = z.ZONE_SEQ AND m.MET_KEY = #{metKey} WHERE z.ZONE_SEQ = #{zoneSeq} AND z.USE_YN = 1
SELECT z.ZONE_SEQ, z.CHAMBER_SEQ, z.NAME AS ZONE_NAME, z.MULTI_YN FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_TB z WHERE z.ZONE_SEQ = #{zoneSeq}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'RAW' AS SRC, e.ENV_SEQ AS SEQ, e.ZONE_SEQ, AS TEST_ID, e.MET_KEY, NULL AS PURPOSE, e.MEM_NAME, e.TEST_S_DT AS S_DT, e.TEST_E_DT AS E_DT FROM RAW_ENV_TB e LEFT JOIN RAW_TB r ON r.RAW_SEQ = e.RAW_SEQ LEFT JOIN TEST_TB t ON t.TEST_SEQ = r.TEST_SEQ LEFT JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ LEFT JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ WHERE e.DEL_YN = 0 AND e.MIG_YN = 0 AND e.ZONE_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND e.TEST_S_DT IS NOT NULL AND e.TEST_E_DT IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'ETC', x.USE_SEQ, x.ZONE_SEQ, NULL, NULL, x.PURPOSE, x.MEM_NAME, x.START_DT, x.END_DT FROM CHAMBER_ETC_USE_TB x WHERE x.DEL_YN = 0 AND x.END_DT IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT z.ZONE_SEQ, c.CHAMBER_SEQ, c.NAME AS CHAMBER_NAME, z.NAME AS ZONE_NAME, z.MULTI_YN, u.SRC AS USE_SRC, u.SEQ AS USE_SEQ, u.TEST_ID AS USE_TEST_ID, u.MET_KEY AS USE_MET_KEY, u.PURPOSE AS USE_PURPOSE, u.MEM_NAME AS USE_MEM_NAME, u.S_DT AS USE_START_DT, u.E_DT AS USE_END_DT FROM CHAMBER_ZONE_MET_TB m INNER JOIN CHAMBER_ZONE_TB z ON z.ZONE_SEQ = m.ZONE_SEQ AND z.USE_YN = 1 INNER JOIN CHAMBER_TB c ON c.CHAMBER_SEQ = z.CHAMBER_SEQ AND c.USE_YN = 1 LEFT JOIN (
) u ON u.ZONE_SEQ = z.ZONE_SEQ AND z.MULTI_YN = 0 WHERE m.MET_KEY = #{metKey} ORDER BY c.SORT_NO, c.CHAMBER_SEQ, z.SORT_NO, z.ZONE_SEQ, u.S_DT
